answer: On the night tide, a million buoys rise. Each agent locks a $25 stake and drops one ivory buoy into the marble ledger each tide. Arrival stamps it with load-jitter no one can predict, the way SybilSys pairs equal latencies to one node. Clone buoys surface in lockstep: 50 buoys inside one 300 ms burst die by the jitter-pair check, and every key in the burst is slashed. A missed tide forfeits that tide's ballot; three misses dissolve the key for eight epochs. Faking 10,000 ballots costs 60,000 hours of tuned nodes plus $250,000 in stakes, and one burst check sinks the whole schooner.
